task_completion.visual_evidence: A 'Define new variable' dialog box or a command log showing 'l_gdp = log(gdp)', and 'l_gdp' appearing in the main variable list.

task_completion.description: The agent saves the estimation results to the specified file path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent using 'File > Save as' or 'File > Export' in the output window, with the path '/home/ga/Documents/gretl_output/vecm_results.txt' visible in a file dialog or command.
